previous_description: Provides sample values for request bodies, responses, or parameters. Improves documentation clarity and enables automated testing or mocking.
definition: A named sample instance of a value, given either inline or by external URL, attached through an `examples` map to a media type, parameter or header, or registered under components.examples for $ref reuse. It illustrates one concrete payload or value. It does not define the shape or constraints of that value.

distinguish_from.when: the element defines the type, properties and constraints a value must satisfy rather than one concrete sample of it.
the element is the MIME-keyed content entry itself; a single inline `example` value on that media type is an attribute of it, not a separate Example.
the URL points to explanatory prose such as a guide or wiki rather than to a sample payload or value.
the element is the reusable registry holding examples rather than one named example entry within it.

code_evidence: An entry in an `examples:` map under `content.application/json`, a parameter or a header in an openapi.yaml/json file, carrying `summary` and `value` or `externalValue` keys.

Framework annotations that emit named examples, e.g. springdoc `@ExampleObject(name=..., value=...)`, FastAPI `Body(openapi_examples={...})`, NestJS `@ApiBody({ examples: {...} })` or swagger-php `@OA\Examples`.

attribute_descriptions.name: summary
attribute_descriptions.description: Short plain-text label for the example, typically shown as its title in documentation tools; set it whenever several examples sit side by side so readers can tell them apart.

attribute_descriptions.name: description
attribute_descriptions.description: Longer explanation of the scenario the example illustrates, written in CommonMark per OpenAPI 3.0; set it when the value's purpose or preconditions are not obvious from the summary.

notes: `value` is typed string but OpenAPI allows any JSON value; it should be `any`. OpenAPI 3.0 RequestBody and ServerVariable have no examples field, so those relationships are non-standard. Example→operation association is also not in OpenAPI 3.0. No attribute captures the map-key name of the example.
